scenarios.title: A｜被催进度
scenarios.setting: 任务还没到截止日期，但经理不断要求玩家尽快完成。

turns.text: Is that report done yet? I really need it as soon as possible.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m still working on it. I’m on track to finish it by the agreed deadline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still working on it. I’m on track to finish it by the agreed deadline.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Not yet. I should have it ready by three, as we discussed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. I should have it ready by three, as we discussed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’ve finished most of it. I just need some time to check everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve finished most of it. I just need some time to check everything.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can send you the current version now, but it won’t be final.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can send you the current version now, but it won’t be final.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You said I have until three. Why are you rushing me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still working on it. I’m on track to finish it by the agreed deadline.
feedback.explanation: 容易产生冲突

turns.text: Can you get it to me before lunch instead?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I can try, but I may not have enough time to check everything properly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can try, but I may not have enough time to check everything properly.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If it needs to be done before lunch, I’ll need to postpone my other task. Is that okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: If it needs to be done before lunch, I’ll need to postpone my other task. Is that okay?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I could send you a draft before lunch and the final version later.

feedback.naturalExpression: I could send you a draft before lunch and the final version later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Which is more important: finishing it early or completing the full review?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which is more important: finishing it early or completing the full review?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Send me the draft before lunch and finish the review afterward.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay, that works. I’ll send you the draft first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that works. I’ll send you the draft first.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll prioritize the draft and continue reviewing it afterward.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll prioritize the draft and continue reviewing it afterward.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜被要求额外工作
scenarios.setting: 经理临时把一个原本不在玩家计划里的任务交过来。

turns.text: I also need you to take over Jamie’s report this week.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. How should I prioritize it against my current tasks?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How should I prioritize it against my current tasks?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can take a look, but my schedule is already pretty full this week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can take a look, but my schedule is already pretty full this week.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If I take this on, which of my current deadlines can be moved?

feedback.naturalExpression: If I take this on, which of my current deadlines can be moved?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could we go over my workload before I commit to it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we go over my workload before I commit to it?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s not my job.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How should I prioritize it against my current tasks?
feedback.explanation: 有时事实如此，但表达太直接

turns.text: I’d like you to keep your current deadlines and finish this as well.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m concerned that I won’t be able to complete everything to a good standard in that timeframe.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m concerned that I won’t be able to complete everything to a good standard in that timeframe.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think I can realistically finish all three tasks by Friday. Could we decide which ones are the highest priority?

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I can realistically finish all three tasks by Friday. Could we decide which ones are the highest priority?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can take this on, but I’ll need either more time or help with one of my other tasks.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can take this on, but I’ll need either more time or help with one of my other tasks.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could someone else handle part of the report while I focus on the main section?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone else handle part of the report while I focus on the main section?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: All right. Let’s move your other deadline to Monday.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That would make it manageable. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would make it manageable. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Great. In that case, I can take on the report.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. In that case, I can take on the report.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜被要求无偿加班
scenarios.setting: 已经临近下班，经理希望玩家继续留下处理工作。

turns.text: We’re behind on the project. I need everyone to stay a few extra hours tonight.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: How late are you expecting us to stay?

feedback.naturalExpression: How late are you expecting us to stay?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Is this something that has to be finished tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this something that has to be finished tonight?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could we clarify how the extra hours will be handled?**

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we clarify how the extra hours will be handled?**
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Is this considered overtime?**

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this considered overtime?**
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You want us to work for free?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: How late are you expecting us to stay?
feedback.explanation: 太直接

turns.text: Probably two or three hours. We don’t have overtime pay for this project.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I understand it’s urgent, but I’m not comfortable regularly working extra hours without compensation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand it’s urgent, but I’m not comfortable regularly working extra hours without compensation.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m able to stay a little later tonight, but I can’t make unpaid overtime a regular arrangement.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m able to stay a little later tonight, but I can’t make unpaid overtime a regular arrangement.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could we discuss another option, such as adjusting my hours later this week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we discuss another option, such as adjusting my hours later this week?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If overtime isn’t available, could we reduce the scope of what needs to be finished tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: If overtime isn’t available, could we reduce the scope of what needs to be finished tonight?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Could you at least stay for another hour tonight?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I can stay for one hour, but I’ll need to leave after that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay for one hour, but I’ll need to leave after that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can do that tonight. Could we discuss how to handle this going forward?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can do that tonight. Could we discuss how to handle this going forward?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m afraid I can’t stay tonight, but I can prioritize the task first thing tomorrow morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I can’t stay tonight, but I can prioritize the task first thing tomorrow morning.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I can’t stay late today. Is there another way I can help before I leave?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t stay late today. Is there another way I can help before I leave?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: All right. Finish the most urgent part first.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. Which part should I prioritize?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Which part should I prioritize?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll focus on the most urgent items before I leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll focus on the most urgent items before I leave.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
